description: ExerPy is a Python library in the oemof community for exergy analysis of energy-conversion systems. It reads outputs from process simulators including TESPy, Ebsilon Professional and Aspen Plus, then calculates physical and chemical exergy flows and losses by component. Users provide a thermodynamic system model, stream states and a compatible export; outputs are exergy balances and efficiency indicators for the chosen plant or network and operating period. Geographic coverage is a user-defined energy system. MIT source, component classes and documentation are public, although some supported upstream simulators are commercial. A limitation is that exergy losses depend on reference environment and input-state quality; a computed improvement does not establish economic or operational feasibility. ExerPy can assess heat networks, generation plants and industrial energy conversion. The catalogue's model-pypsa concerns electrical system operation at another scale. No commercial software, plant dataset or package was downloaded.
name: ExerPy energy-system exergy analysis
